hint_ladder.title: What's the root?
hint_ladder.text: Advocate comes from 'ad' (to) + 'vocare' (to call). Parang tinatawag mo ang suporta ng iba para sa isang adhikain.

hint_ladder.title: Eliminate the negative
hint_ladder.text: Tanggalin mo agad ang Oppose, Ignore, at Criticize kasi lahat sila ay negative o walang pakialam. Ang advocate ay positive action.

hint_ladder.title: Pin-point the public support
hint_ladder.text: Yung 'publicly support' ay may kasamang salitang 'publicly'—ibig sabihin tahasang pagkilos, hindi tahimik na sang-ayon lang. Yun ang advocate.

hint_ladder.title: Remember the barangay captain
hint_ladder.text: Isipin mo si Kapitan na todo-suporta sa budget: yan ang advocate. Sa exam, hanapin ang salitang nagpapakita ng aktibong pagtulong.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you thought 'oppose' is synonymous, but advocate means to support, not to fight against.

B.text: Correct. Advocate means to publicly support a cause or policy, like a barangay captain pushing for a health center.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you confused it with 'avoid,' but advocate is about active engagement, not ignoring.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you associated it with legal criticism, but advocate in general use means to promote, not find fault.

next_time_rule: Pag nakita mo ang 'advocate,' isipin mo agad na 'to publicly support'—walang halong pagkontra o pananahimik. Simplehan lang!
deconstruct_text:
Sa barangay ninyo, si Kapitan ay nag-aadvocate na palakihin ang budget para sa health center. Ibig sabihin, todo-suporta siya at hindi lang puro salita. 'Advocate' ay hindi nangangahulugang tumututol o pumipintas.

Madaling tandaan: 'Advo' parang 'advance,' kaya hindi ka aatras—sa halip, isusulong mo! Sa exam, kapag may advocate, ang pinakamalapit na kahulugan ay 'publicly support' dahil laging may aksyon at hindi passive.

**Watch-Out Zone: synonym_antonym_inversion** in action. Akala mo kalaban, pero ally pala!
